rows.response_text: To make a chef hat, start by cutting two pieces of card stock: one 1/2 inch by 11 inches and another 1 1/4 inches by 11 inches. Use these as your measuring guides for the pleated section of the hat. Next, tape two pieces of paper end to end with an overlap of one inch, to give you a piece of paper 8 1/2 inches by 21 inches. If you want a larger hat, you may need a third piece of paper. Use the 1 1/4 inch guide to mark along the long edge of the paper and fold along the line. Then, tape the half-inch tab of the first sheet to the 1 1/4 inches tab of the second, repeating until you form a continuous pleated strip.
